subject.title: [Bug]: Preflight compaction failure permanently locks Composer into "terminated" state

question: Which preflight compaction recovery direction should be canonical for this issue: narrowed runtime retryability, UI lifecycle recovery, or timeout-bounded compaction?
rationale: Current main is source-reproducibly broken, but the issue discussion and overlapping PRs show an unresolved compatibility decision about which failure classes may safely fail open.

options.title: Use narrowed runtime retryability
options.body: Bless timeout, true 429 rate-limit, and 5xx as skipped guardrail outcomes while keeping auth, request-shape, quota, and billing failures terminal; this matches the strongest current PR direction.

options.title: Use UI lifecycle recovery
options.body: Keep compaction failures terminal in the runtime and make chat.dispatch-error restore the Composer with an actionable error path.

options.title: Use timeout-bounded compaction
options.body: Make only elapsed compaction time fail open, leaving provider error classification unchanged.

recommendation.title: Use narrowed runtime retryability
recommendation.body: Bless timeout, true 429 rate-limit, and 5xx as skipped guardrail outcomes while keeping auth, request-shape, quota, and billing failures terminal; this matches the strongest current PR direction.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion requests Vincent Koc's guidance after his prior retryability feedback on an earlier same-root PR.
